# TruKid Bubbly Body Wash, Daily Natural Cleansing, 32 oz

## Gentle Daily Cleansing for Sensitive Skin

Wash off a busy day of school or play with TruKid Bubbly Body Wash. This natural formula, enriched with aloe vera and sugar, removes dirt and surface oils while keeping sensitive skin comfortable. It's pediatrician and dermatologist tested and free of phthalates and parabens, so families can feel good about everyday bath time.

## A Soothing Citrus Scent

Light citrus oils bring a fresh, cheerful aroma to every wash. The natural aromatherapy benefits help calm the mood, turning bath time into a relaxing routine that kids look forward to.

## Extra-Gentle, Fun Bubbles

Extra-gentle suds make cleansing playful, and the formula doubles as a bubble bath for extra fun at bedtime.

## Thoughtful, Easy-to-Use Packaging

The 32 oz bottle features a pump top for easy dispensing. The formula is BPA-free, PETA Certified Animal Cruelty-Free, and made in the USA.

## Make Bath Time Easier

TruKid Bubbly Body Wash helps children leave the tub with soft, refreshed skin, ready for their next adventure or a restful night's sleep. Add it to your cart today and make clean, gentle bath time a daily favorite.
